block-guide:
CORE/MEDIA-TEXT An image (or video) beside text, two columns that stack on phones. The text side holds normal blocks (heading, paragraph, buttons…) inside wp-block-media-text__content. MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Title

Text beside the picture.

MEDIA "mediaType":"image" is required (or "video"); without it the figure stays empty. mediaUrl and mediaAlt are NOT in the comment: they are read from the src and alt. Library image: "mediaId": + class "wp-image- size-full" on the (size- when set; full otherwise) -> WordPress adds srcset. External image: no mediaId, no class at all. Video: inside the figure. OPTIONS mediaPosition "right": class has-media-on-the-right AND the content
comes BEFORE the figure. Left (default) = figure first, no class. mediaWidth (default 50, %): any other value writes style="grid-template-columns:40% auto" (left) or "auto 40%" (right) on the outer div. isStackedOnMobile defaults to true and writes is-stacked-on-mobile; "isStackedOnMobile":false drops the class. verticalAlignment top|center|bottom -> is-vertically-aligned-. imageFill true -> class is-image-fill-element and style="object-position:50% 50%" on the img (from focalPoint {"x","y"} when given): the image fills its column, cropped. Link around the image: inside the figure wrapping the ; href is read from it. Class order: wp-block-media-text, align class, has-media-on-the-right, is-stacked-on-mobile, is-vertically-aligned-…, is-image-fill-element. CHECK Open the page wide and narrow (columns, then stacked); reopen the editor: no invalid-content notice.
